crop_flow_and_image_pairs: crop optical flow .flo files and image pairs into patches by specifying input directory, output directory, and crop coordinates
crop_flow_files_by_location: crop .flo optical flow files from an input directory into patches at a given x, y, height, and width location
crop_image_files_by_location: crop .png image files from an input directory into patches at a given x, y, height, and width location
run_crop_file_cli: run the crop_file.py script with argparse to crop flow and image files recursively from an input directory to an output directory
customize_crop_file_formats: run crop_file.py with --image_format and --flow_format flags to crop non-default file extensions like .jpg or .npy
